topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: I wasn't looking for anything out of the ordinary when I decided to move that old bookshelf. It was just too heavy, too immobile, like it didn't fit. Underneath, the wallpaper peeled back to reveal a faint outline, a door long forgotten. The handle was cold, and it creaked as it opened, hesitant, like it hadn't breathed in years. Inside, the air was thick, stale. The light from the hallway barely scratched the surface of the darkness. I stepped in, slowly, each step heavier than the last, my heart pounding in my ears. The room was empty, but the walls seemed to whisper, and I knew I had to leave, quick.
